1.title: 700-Pound Sea Lion Is Found to Have Been Shot at Least 12 Times
1.summary: The California sea lion was found dead on a beach off the Duwamish River in West Seattle, Wash., this month. A motive for the shooting was unclear.

2.title: Nor'easter brings flooding as New York and New Jersey declare emergency
2.summary: Tens of millions of people from Maine to Virginia are in the path of the powerful storm.

3.title: Trump Rejects Iran’s Cease-Fire Proposal to Reopen Strait of Hormuz
3.summary: The president said the deal was not “acceptable” and demurred on whether he would restart military strikes after the midterm elections.

4.title: Carney Seeks New Trade Partners for Canada, But Knows the Limits
4.summary: Canada’s prime minister is pursuing deeper trade, defense and cultural ties with China, India and the European Union, but none are likely to replace ties to the United States.

5.title: Evicted 87-Year-Old Woman Urges Spaniards to ‘Fight’ to Avoid Same Fate
5.summary: María del Carmen Abascal, whose case has become a symbol of Spain’s housing crisis, appeared in a video from a hospital bed after being removed from her apartment.

6.title: Trump rejects Iran deal to reopen Strait of Hormuz in seven days
6.summary: Iran's foreign minister acknowledges Trump's comments, but adds that Tehran is waiting for the "definitive views" of mediators.
